description: One employee's payslip for one month worked; all amounts in VND.
The month paid (YYYY-MM).
The position held that month.
Working days in the month (weekdays less public holidays).
Days employed in the month, less unpaid leave.
Monthly base salary in force that month, before proration.
base_salary prorated by worked_days / standard_days.
Position and meal allowances, prorated by days worked.
Pay for overtime_hours at 1.5 times the hourly rate.
Sum of the employee's bonuses paid that month.
salary_pay + allowances + overtime_pay + bonus_total.
Salary insurance is computed on, before each insurance's cap; 0 when worked_days is under 14.
Employee's BHXH (social insurance) deduction.
Employee's BHYT (health insurance) deduction.
Employee's BHTN (unemployment insurance) deduction.
Personal income tax deduction for the employee.
Tax deduction for the employee's dependents.
gross_income less the employee's insurance and the deductions, never below 0.
Personal income tax withheld that month.
Deductions for damaged property taken that month.
Paid to the employee: gross_income less the employee's insurance, personal_income_tax and penalty_total.
Insurance the company pays on top of gross_income.
What the employee costs the company that month: gross_income + employer_insurance.
